Both were authored by the orchestrating session that ran the Executor, and both predate this receipt. This task therefore staged and committed no producer content, and it is the direct cause of the defect recorded under verification.commit_binding: a snapshot archive can only bind a commit it makes, so once the work it was to archive was already committed, the specification it was given became impossible to satisfy.
